createQuiz.title: Create a quiz
createQuiz.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Assignment & Assessment module.
createQuiz.step2: Pick the Quiz Bank section from the submenu.
createQuiz.step3: Click the Create Quiz button to start building a new quiz.

createPersonalRequest.title: Create a personal request
createPersonalRequest.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Communication & Reporting module.
createPersonalRequest.step2: Pick the Personal Request section from the submenu.
createPersonalRequest.step3: Click the New Personal Request button to open the request form.

checkSchedule.title: Check my schedule
checkSchedule.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Dashboard & Scheduling module.
checkSchedule.step2: Pick the Schedule Management section from the submenu.
checkSchedule.step3: Explore the calendar: switch between Day, Week, and Month views and click a block to see lesson details.

takeQuiz.title: Take a quiz
takeQuiz.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Assignment & Assessment module.
takeQuiz.step2: Pick the Quiz Bank section from the submenu.
takeQuiz.step3: Select a quiz from the list, then click Take Quiz to start answering questions.

viewGrades.title: View my grades
viewGrades.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Grading & Attendance module.
viewGrades.step2: On the My Grades tab, review the average grade, present rate, absences, and per-subject progress.

startChat.title: Start a chat
startChat.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Communication & Reporting module.
startChat.step2: Pick the Chat section from the submenu.
startChat.step3: Choose a conversation and start typing in the composer at the bottom.

shareFile.title: Share a file
shareFile.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Communication & Reporting module.
shareFile.step2: Pick the File Sharing section from the submenu.
shareFile.step3: Click the Upload File button and choose the file you want to share.

changePassword.title: Change my password
changePassword.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Profile & General Info page.
changePassword.step2: Click the Change Password button, then enter your old and new passwords.

editProfile.title: Edit my profile
editProfile.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Profile & General Info page.
editProfile.step2: Click the Edit Profile button, then update your details and save.

viewDashboard.title: View the dashboard
viewDashboard.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Dashboard & Scheduling module.
viewDashboard.step2: Pick the Dashboard section from the submenu.
viewDashboard.step3: Review the dashboard widgets and statistics for your role.

viewProgressTracker.title: View the progress tracker
viewProgressTracker.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Dashboard & Scheduling module.
viewProgressTracker.step2: Pick the Progress Tracker section from the submenu.
viewProgressTracker.step3: Review the progress overview and click a course to drill down into its lessons.

createCourseBuilder.title: Create a course master
createCourseBuilder.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Course Management module.
createCourseBuilder.step2: Pick the Course Builder section from the submenu.
createCourseBuilder.step3: Click the Add button to create a new course master.

createCourseSelection.title: Create a course iteration
createCourseSelection.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Course Management module.
createCourseSelection.step2: Pick the Course Selection section from the submenu.
createCourseSelection.step3: Click the Add button to create a new course iteration from a course master.

viewEnrolledStudents.title: View enrolled students
viewEnrolledStudents.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Course Management module.
viewEnrolledStudents.step2: Pick the Enrolled Students section from the submenu.
viewEnrolledStudents.step3: Browse the list of enrolled students and use the filters to narrow it down.

viewLibrary.title: View the library
viewLibrary.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Course Management module.
viewLibrary.step2: Pick the Library section from the submenu.
viewLibrary.step3: Browse the library and click a document to open it in the reader.

createForm.title: Create a form
createForm.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Grading & Attendance module.
createForm.step2: Pick the Form section from the submenu.
createForm.step3: Click the Create Form button, then fill in the form details.

viewForm.title: View a form
viewForm.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Grading & Attendance module.
viewForm.step2: Pick the Form section from the submenu.
viewForm.step3: Select a form from the list to view its questions and details.

takeForm.title: Take a form
takeForm.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Grading & Attendance module.
takeForm.step2: Pick the Form section from the submenu.
takeForm.step3: Select a form sent to you, then click Take Form to start answering.

createSurvey.title: Create a survey
createSurvey.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Grading & Attendance module.
createSurvey.step2: Pick the Survey section from the submenu.
createSurvey.step3: Click the Create Survey button, then fill in the survey details.

viewSurvey.title: View a survey
viewSurvey.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Grading & Attendance module.
viewSurvey.step2: Pick the Survey section from the submenu.
viewSurvey.step3: Select a survey from the list to view its questions and details.

takeSurvey.title: Take a survey
takeSurvey.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Grading & Attendance module.
takeSurvey.step2: Pick the Survey section from the submenu.
takeSurvey.step3: Select a survey sent to you, then click Take Survey to start answering.

viewAttendance.title: View attendance
viewAttendance.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Grading & Attendance module.
viewAttendance.step2: Pick the Class Attendance section from the submenu.
viewAttendance.step3: Review the attendance records and use the filters to narrow them down.

createVirtualClassroom.title: Create a virtual classroom session
createVirtualClassroom.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Communication & Reporting module.
createVirtualClassroom.step2: Pick the Virtual Classroom section from the submenu.
createVirtualClassroom.step3: Click the Create Session button, then fill in the session details.

joinVirtualClassroom.title: Join a virtual classroom
joinVirtualClassroom.step1: In the left sidebar, open the Communication & Reporting module.
joinVirtualClassroom.step2: Pick the Virtual Classroom section from the submenu.
